audience: HR teams and managers who read employee, absence and timesheet data from Cezanne HR

useCases.title: List new joiners and leavers
useCases.text: List people, with leavers and new hires included, using an OData filter. Read the next page with the next_skip value.

useCases.title: Check the current employment of a person
useCases.text: Read one person by Person Code. Then read that person's current primary employment.

useCases.title: Review absence events for a team
useCases.text: List the absence events, filtered by date or by person. Compare the events with the org units of the team.

useCases.title: Read timesheet entries for a period
useCases.text: List the person timesheets for a period. Read the timesheet detail table for the entries behind them.
